fact_reviews.old_value: Matrix-state identities enter through `HSD_PObjClearMtxMark` and, by interface intent, `HSD_PObjSetMtxMark`; `HSD_PObjGetMtxMark` copies a selected slot into caller-owned object and mark outputs. Rigid and shared-vertex setup compare those outputs with current or PObj-attached JObjs and `HSD_MTX_RIGID` to control GX matrix loads. General JObj display clears both slots to `(NULL, 0)`, while envelope setup clears them to `(NULL, HSD_MTX_ENVELOPE)`. In the matched setter body, valid indices 0 and 1 discard their supplied values, so normal setter calls produce no write to this storage.
